mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS has increased by more than 0.2% over the last 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 1.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12mo change is below 1.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS above 1.0% and CPIAUCSL index above 250.0), the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (measured as the 3-month change in HOUST) causes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST has increased by more than 0.5% over the last 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300.0 and residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 500000.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 500000.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (defined by 3-month non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 0.3% and unemployment rate below 4.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
